description:
APPLICATION FOR THE DEMOLITION OF EXISTING
REAR ADDITIONS, INCLUDING THE CONSERVATORY AND REAR/SIDE EXTENSIONS, AND
CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION WITH A FLAT ROOF
INCORPORATING FIVE ROOFLIGHTS. THE WORKS ALSO INCLUDE ASSOCIATED ALTERATIONS TO
THE EXISTING DWELLING, COMPRISING INTERNAL RECONFIGURATION, REFURBISHMENT AND
THE REPLACEMENT OF WINDOWS AND DOORS.
